The release-channel publisher (`scripts/release_channel/publish.py`) now also publishes the `[web_channels.<channel>]` entries of `apps/minds/release-channels.toml` as `<channel>-web.json`: the template tag browser-created workspaces pin to, per channel. The web entries carry only `template_ref` (a `minds-vX.Y.Z` tag), are gated on the tag existing on the default-workspace-template remote, and report and no-op like the desktop entries. The new `web_channels.py` module is self-contained on purpose; a `CLEANUP` note in `publish.py` says to fold it into the per-platform machinery of `mngr/linux-packaging` once both branches are on main.

The `release-minds` skill's production section now sequences deploy the connector, bake the pool, verify a lease, then repoint both the desktop and web channels (a new step 4 substep), and retires the old pool generation only after every web channel has left its tag, with the staging/dev caveat that tiers without an update feed still bake before they deploy. Its state-detection commands and resume table gain the web channel pin and the connector's `/version`.
